text:
ellie (CS): Heads-up — Auriga renewal is in a bit of a twist. They completed an acquisition and procurement now says invoice must go to the acquired entity (Auriga Labs Ltd). They insist on PO + vendor code tied to the new entity. Also requested Net60. Onboarding warns migration workshop won't run until agreement + deposit are processed. Can we align today?

mark (AE): Got on a call earlier. Customer verbally agreed to 18mo term at current rate, but procurement is stubborn about the invoice entity change. Vendor code AL-2026-01. They will email PO only if the contract explicitly lists Auriga Labs Ltd as invoiced entity.

neha (Legal): If we change invoice entity we need a short addendum. Also Net60 for an 18mo with no upfront deposit increases revenue recognition exposure. Finance must sign off. Draft addendum snippet: 

"Addendum: Seller will invoice Auriga Labs Ltd (Company No. 9876543). Payment terms amended to Net60 from invoice date for this renewal only. All other terms unchanged. Seller reserves the right to require an upfront deposit for extended payment terms."

dylan (Onboarding): Operational impact: migration workshop requires full access and a data import window. We need signed agreement and either deposit or cleared payment 7 days before workshop start (planned 2026-07-12). If those aren't in place by 2026-07-05, we'll have to delay workshop two weeks. Can do a 30-min kickoff earlier.

ellie (CS): Can procurement attach PO to a DocuSign envelope and include vendor code? That usually gets billing happy. I'll ping procurement contact.

procurement-bot: Procurement note: Auriga procurement will only issue PO after official invoicing entity is on contract. PO expected within 24 hours once addendum added. Will not accept CC.

mark (AE): I floated a compromise: 18mo at current rate + 5% prepay discount if they can do 30% upfront via CC and remainder Net60 to the new entity. They said they'd consider but prefer zero upfront.

finance-bot: Ticket created: FIN-4532. Finance requires approval for Net60 on 18mo with no deposit. Suggested options: (1) require 30% deposit, (2) approve Net60 for two billing cycles only, or (3) hold to Net30. Please tag finance for rapid decision.

neha (Legal): I'll prepare an addendum that includes optional deposit language so we can accept either path. Example clause: 

"Option A: Customer shall remit 30% deposit within 7 days of signature; remaining balance invoiced Net60 to Auriga Labs Ltd. Option B: If no deposit, payment terms revert to Net30."

ellie (CS): Good. I'll propose Option A to the customer so onboarding can proceed. Mark, can you ask procurement for PO plus a scanned confirmation for startup?

mark (AE): Sending draft addendum now to procurement. I'll ask if they can scan/email PO immediately for DocuSign attachment.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope env-auriga-2026 created by ellie (CS). Pending signatures: Auriga Procurement, mark (AE), ellie (CS). Link: https://docusign.example/env-auriga-2026

procurement-bot: Auriga replied — PO in progress but will only issue after addendum includes Auriga Labs Ltd and deposit option removed. They do not want to commit to deposit.

neha (Legal): Updated addendum removing mandatory deposit; included clause allowing finance to accept deposit or require Net30 if not approved. Sent to ellie for signature flow.

ellie (CS): Sent envelope link and asked procurement to attach PO scan if ready. Also proposed a phased onboarding: 30-min kickoff (no migration) the week of 2026-07-05, full workshop contingent on funds.

procurement-bot: PO sent (scanned) PO# AL-PO-2026-888 attached to email. Forwarded to billing@redwood.com and uploaded to DocuSign envelope.

esign-bot: PO uploaded to env-auriga-2026 by procurement-bot.

finance-bot: After review, FIN-4532 approved conditional Net60 for this renewal with a credit hold until PO payment posts. Accounting will flag invoice INV-2026-7707 as Net60 but with payment hold. Please confirm routing.

mark (AE): Customer signed DocuSign moments ago. Procurement confirmed they'll process payment per PO timelines.

dylan (Onboarding): Received confirmation — scheduling tentative kickoff 2026-07-12, holding migration window. Will send pre-migration checklist; keep customers aware of dependency on payment posting.

ellie (CS): Thanks all. I'll run a short post-kickoff feedback and capture any renewal friction notes (procurement, legal). Closing for now and will reopen if payment stalls. :white_check_mark:
file_note: Renewal thread: invoice-entity change due to acquisition, PO-required procurement, Net60 request for 18mo term, finance approval process, addendum drafting, DocuSign envelope with PO attachment, onboarding migration timing risk, customer feedback capture.
